Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Thai

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Thai
public class Thai extends Object
Thai-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_THAI section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x0d.
